constraints: The check scans forward from checkPos and stops at the first unknown word found (if any).

The OK system variable is set to 0 if the check completes without an initialization error and an unknown word is found; OK is set to 1 if an initialization error occurs, or if no unknown words are found.
macOS: when the native spell checker is enabled, this command does not support grammar correction.

overloadMerges.note: autoparse defaulted every param to direction:"in" from the blanket rule; the doc parameter table's arrow column marks errPos, errLength and arrSuggest as "<-" (out) since they are filled by the command, while text and checkPos are "->" (in).
